messages.subject: Aesthetics Problem Using "geom_line"
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm relatively new to R so please bear with me. I'm trying to make a longitudinal graph similar to the picture I attached. The process of coding to make the data frame "combinedgroupsdataframe" was very long and tedious, so I didn't paste that below. However, I can simplify it and say that the data includes two groups: drug and placebo. A number from 0 to 10 was recorded for each of the 50 people in each group for 154 days. This means that there are 15500 values total, as calculated in the error message below. Please let me know if you need more information. 


The steps leading up to the error message are as follows:

> colnames(combinedgroupsdataframe)[3] <- "Day"

> library(ggplot2)

> ggplot(combinedgroupsdataframe, aes(x=Day, y=combinedgroupsdataframe, colour=Trial_Group, Group=Patient_ID)) + geom_line(alpha=.5)


And this is the error message I received:

Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type data.frame. Defaulting to continuous.

Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (15500): x, y, colour, Group


I know that there was a similar post about this, but that involved the person using qplot when you all suggested they use ggplot. This is what I'm using already.


Does anyone have any idea what I'm doing wrong?


Thanks,

Destini

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Aesthetics Problem Using "geom_line"
parts:
Destini, you need to set 'y' equal to a column name, *not* the name of the data frame, e.g.

ggplot(combinedgroupsdataframe, aes(x=Day, y=value, ...

Ben
